description:
"Now that we have no ill feelings towards each other, let's live our separate lives well and never see each other again."
   
It was the start of a possession that began with a typical regretful family drama. After cutting ties with a family that doesn't get along with each other, I thought a peaceful unemployed life was waiting for me. However... For some reason, men who had no interest in me before the possession started creeping in.   

"I have something I like."   

"What is it?"   

"It's you, Lora." The slave who I brought because I felt sorry for him getting beat up now confessed.   

"Why doesn't Laura take care of herself? I'll take care of her from now on." The condition of the butler, who is of mixed race, became strange.   

"Lora, will you marry me?" The Grand Duke, who used to threaten me, proposed.   

"Haa, this sweet smell... you're the first one to drive me this crazy." This crazy man seems even crazier.   

...I wish they'd all just disappear.
